summary.title: FRX
summary.description: FRX requirements and architecture threat model. Scope: local portal, browser/API users, identity/report storage, standalone document intake, event logging and a local analytics provider. Threats are planning scenarios, not verified code findings. Existing controls are limited to explicitly identified architecture constraints; other controls are proposals. Requirement and assumption identifiers are defined in requirements-and-architecture.md. No risk acceptance or production-readiness claim is made.

threats.title: Repeated requests exhaust service capacity
threats.description: Preconditions: A caller can repeatedly reach this interface; normal protected operations require a session. Assets: Local service availability. Consequences: Request work could delay report review, especially when file, database or provider work shares capacity. Architecture constraints: Loopback exposure and bounded portal request bodies limit some inputs; rate limits and capacity guarantees are unverified. Basis: REQ-04, ARC-01, ASM-01. Verification status: planning scenario; not tested.
threats.mitigation: Proposed controls: Define request/concurrency budgets and ensure advisory-provider failure does not prevent report review. Verification plan: Use an agreed bounded load profile and provider-failure scenarios. Owner and disposition: unassigned; review pending.
